title: 第23章 排位赛开始
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
月末，全年级排位赛。

    演武场比开学那天的摸底测试热闹了十倍，四周的观战台上坐满了人。

    不光有本年级的学生，还有不少二三年级的学长学姐来看热闹，甚至有几个教官搬了椅子坐在场边，像在看戏。

    苏念念站在演武场边上，校服外套扎在腰间，露出里面的白色素T，马尾扎得高高的，整个人散发着一股准备干架的气势。

    “紧张吗？”安槐站在她旁边问。

    “紧张个屁。”苏念念活动了一下手腕，骨节啪啪作响，“我就想打人。”

    安槐笑了笑。

    排位赛的规则比摸底测试复杂。

    全年级按修为分成三个层级，高层淬体五重以上，中层三到四重，低层一到二重。

    每个层级内部抽签对战，胜者积分，最终综合排名。

    安槐在高层，苏念念在中层，层级不同，不会直接对上。

    大屏幕上滚动出第一轮分组。

    安槐扫了一眼自己的对手，二年级的一个六重，叫方锐，二班的，没什么印象。

    苏念念的对手是四班的一个男生，淬体四重，身高一米八三，体重至少九十公斤。纯粹的力量型选手。

    苏念念歪头看了一眼大屏幕上对方的照片。

    “长得跟衣柜似的。”

    安槐低头看她。“这种对手最好不要硬碰硬，用身法拉扯他的节奏，等他露出空档再切入。”

    “我知道。”苏念念翻了个白眼，“你教了我回流掌你忘了？”

    “没忘。”

    “那你别操心了，看你自己的比赛去。”苏念念推了他一把，“第一轮，你哪个场地？”

    “三号台。”

    “我在五号台。”苏念念皱了皱鼻子，“离得有点远，看不到你打。”

    安槐想了想。“我会打快一点，争取过来看老大的比赛。”

    苏念念嘴角弯了一下，佯装嫌弃地挥了挥手。

    “去去去。”

    第一轮比赛开始。

    三号台上，安槐面对的方锐是个沉稳型选手，上来就摆好防守架势，打算先观察再出手。

    安槐没给他观察的时间。

    起手直接切入近身距离，左手虚晃引开他的注意力，右手沿着一个极小的弧线直接扣在对方的肩缝上。

    借力一带，膝盖横推。

    方锐的重心被瞬间打破，整个人侧翻出去，在减震垫上滚了一圈，脸朝下趴着没反应过来。

    全程不到两秒。

    场边寂静了一瞬，随即爆发出一片惊呼。

    教官面无表情地在评分表上写了一个数字。

    安槐走下台，朝五号台的方向快步走去。

    苏念念的比赛刚刚进入第三回合。

    那个体格如衣柜的男生确实力气大，每一拳砸过来都带着沉闷的风声。

    但苏念念的身法比他快了不止一个档次，在他攻击范围的边缘来回穿行，像一只灵巧的燕子在风暴边缘跳舞。

    男生打了六拳，一拳都没碰到她。

    第七拳的时候，他终于急了，发力过猛，重心前倾。

    苏念念等的就是这个瞬间。

    她的左手接住他挥空的前臂，掌心贴着他的手腕，一个回流掌。

    对方的拳劲被她卸掉七成，剩余的力道反弹回去推在了他自己的小臂上，男生手臂一麻，攻势一滞。

    苏念念右脚踏前半步，断岳拳第四式，短距离爆发。
content_en:
At the end of the month, there will be a qualifying competition for all grades.

The martial arts field was ten times more lively than the test on the first day of school, and the surrounding spectator stands were full of people.

Not only students of this grade, but also many second- and third-grade seniors came to watch the fun. There were even a few instructors who moved chairs and sat on the sidelines, as if they were watching a show.

Su Niannian stood on the edge of the martial arts field, her school uniform jacket tied around her waist, revealing the white T-shirt underneath, her tail tied high, and her whole person exuding an aura of being ready for a fight.

"Are you nervous?" An Huai asked standing next to her.

"I'm so nervous." Su Niannian moved her wrist and her joints crackled, "I just want to hit someone."

An Huai smiled.

The rules of qualifying are more complicated than the testing.

The whole grade is divided into three levels according to their cultivation level. The high-level body tempering level is above five levels, the middle level is three to four levels, and the low level is one to two levels.

Each level will draw lots for internal competition, the winner will get points, and the final overall ranking will be determined.

An Huai is at the top and Su Niannian is at the middle. They are at different levels and will not face each other directly.

The first round of groupings scrolled out on the big screen.

An Huai glanced at his opponent. He was a second-year sixth-level student named Fang Rui. He was from the second class. He didn't have much impression.

Su Niannian's opponent was a boy from Class 4, who was in the fourth level of body tempering. He was 1.83 meters tall and weighed at least 90 kilograms.Pure strength player.

Su Niannian tilted her head and glanced at the photo of the other party on the big screen.

"It looks like a wardrobe."

An Huai looked down at her."It's best not to confront this kind of opponent head-on, use your body skills to slow down his rhythm, and wait for him to reveal an opening before cutting in."

"I know." Su Niannian rolled her eyes, "You taught me the Return Palm, have you forgotten?"

"I haven't forgotten."

"Then don't worry about it, just watch your own game." Su Niannian pushed him, "In the first round, which venue do you want?"

"Channel 3."

"I'm at Channel 5." Su Niannian wrinkled her nose, "It's a bit far away, so I can't see you playing."

An Huai thought for a while."I will play faster and try to come over to watch the boss's game."

Su Niannian curled her mouth and waved her hand in feigned disgust.

"Go, go, go."

The first round begins.

On the third stage, An Huai faced Fang Rui, a calm player. He put on a defensive stance and planned to observe first before taking action.

An Huai didn't give him time to observe.

The starting hand directly cuts into the close distance, the left hand feints to attract his attention, and the right hand follows a very small arc and directly buckles the opponent's shoulder seam.

Leverage your strength and push your knees horizontally.

Fang Rui's center of gravity was instantly broken. He rolled over on his side and rolled around on the shock absorbing pad. He lay face down without reacting.

The whole process takes less than two seconds.

There was silence on the sidelines for a moment, and then there was an exclamation of surprise.

The instructor wrote a number on the score sheet without expression.

An Huai walked off the stage and walked quickly in the direction of Stage 5.

Su Niannian's game has just entered the third round.

The boy who was as big as a wardrobe was indeed very strong, and every punch he punched came with a dull sound.

But Su Niannian's movement was more than one level faster than his, walking back and forth on the edge of his attack range, like a nimble swallow dancing on the edge of the storm.

The boy punched her six times, but none of them touched her.

On the seventh punch, he finally got impatient, used too much force, and leaned forward.

Su Niannian was waiting for this moment.

Her left hand caught his free forearm, her palm pressed against his wrist, a return palm.

She removed 70% of the strength of the opponent's punch, and the remaining strength rebounded and pushed against his own forearm. The boy's arm went numb and his offensive stagnated.

Su Niannian took a half step forward with her right foot, using the fourth form of Duanyue Fist, a short-distance burst.
